name: forward-app-theme-carry-unknown-member
description: FORWARD tolerance on the theme CARRY read (ggui#1155, VERSION-POLICY §3.6): a theme GET response exactly as a LATER release's door returns it — the stored document VERBATIM, carrying a synthetic `futureMember` this release does not name, with `interpreted.stripped` naming it. Today's response schema must accept it with the member INTACT, and the names in `interpreted.stripped` must be exactly the members today's parser cannot name. A reader that strips here is the ggui#1124 defect at the door built to prevent it.

release.label: a later ggui release (synthetic): the theme GET's response with a synthetic `futureMember`
